headline: Earnings surge, but full-year cash guidance trimmed

kpis.label: EPS (Class A & C, basic and diluted)

summary_short: Net income attributable to Clearway rose to $122M and Adjusted EBITDA grew 19% y/y to $409M in Q2 2026, but the company cut full-year 2026 CAFD guidance to $430-470M from $470-510M on updated renewable production estimates.
summary_long: Revenue rose 22.7% y/y to $481M as Renewables & Storage generation grew 16% on growth-investment contributions, driving Adjusted EBITDA up 19.2% to $409M and CAFD up 9.9% to $167M. Net income attributable to Clearway jumped to $122M (from $30M) largely on mark-to-market swings on economic hedges; consolidated net income before noncontrolling interests was $30M. The company lowered full-year 2026 guidance: CAFD to $430-470M (from $470-510M), Adjusted EBITDA to $1,393-1,433M (from $1,441-1,481M), and Cash from Operating Activities to $956-996M (from $1,022-1,062M), citing updated renewable production estimates and factors outlined in its mid-July operational preview. Total liquidity fell to $985M from $1,061M at year-end 2025; long-term debt rose to $8,491M.

drivers.explanation: Renewables & Storage segment generation was 16% higher y/y, which the release attributes to the contribution of growth investments; Flexible Generation availability was also higher on strong operational execution.
Release states consolidated net income increased versus Q2 2025 primarily due to changes in mark-to-market for economic hedges.
Release attributes the y/y increase to the contribution of growth investments, consistent with the Renewables & Storage segment's Adjusted EBITDA rising from $300M to $372M.
Release states CAFD was higher than Q2 2025 primarily due to higher EBITDA.

CEO Craig Cornelius said the company is 'lowering our 2026 financial guidance due to factors outlined in our mid-July operational preview' while reaffirming its long-term 2030 CAFD-per-share growth targets.
